28a.name: Flint Hills
28a.desc: The grass-covered Flint Hills are underlain by cherty limestone and shale. Shallow, stony, upland soils are common and unsuited to farming. Rangeland and grassland predominate. Extensive cropland and major hydrological modifications do not occur. As a result, many natural channels remain nearly intact.
